Harhi College : An overview
Harhi College was set up on 1996 (Academic Session 1998-1999) and its is situated at a beautiful landscape on the bank of the river Charikoria of the rural Sub-division Dhakuakhana, P.O.- Gobinapur in the District of North Lakhimpur (Assam), Pin- 787055. It is only a premier institution of Higher Education, covering almost 05 G.P. where most of the people basically belong to ST, SC, OBC and MOBC. The college is now till the date of establishment, imparting higher education and providing knowledge and skill in the faculty of Arts among the students.
